definitions.explanation: The standard expression for sweating physically, whether from heat, exercise, or nervousness.

definitions.gloss: to work hard; to put in effort
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, to exert oneself or work hard at something, implying hands-on labor rather than directing from above.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暑|あつ}くて→暑い：00619_atsui⟧{汗|あせ}をかいた。
examples.english: I sweated because it was hot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{気持|きも}ちよく→気持ちいい：09583_kimochiii⟧⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: After exercising, you can work up a refreshing sweat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{緊張|きんちょう}して→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{汗|あせ}をかいて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I was so nervous that my palms were sweating.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{汗|あせ}をかかない⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can't grow unless you put in the effort yourself.
Leaders should also get their hands dirty on the ground.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{倍|ばい}→倍：01492_bai⟧{汗|あせ}をかいて⟦{働|はたら}いて→働く：00503_hataraku⟧きた。
examples.english: He has worked twice as hard as others since he was young.

notes:
USAGE:
The verb かく here is a special usage meaning "to produce" (sweat). Note that this かく is written in hiragana, not with the kanji ⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ or ⟦{掻|か}く→掻く：09647_kaku⟧.

FORMS:
- {冷|ひ}や{汗|あせ}をかく: to break out in a cold sweat (from fear or a close call)
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{汗|あせ}をかく: to have sweaty palms (from nervousness or excitement)
- ⟦{脂汗|あぶらあせ}をかく→脂汗をかく：25159_aburaasewokaku⟧: to break out in a greasy sweat (from pain or extreme stress)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- びっしょり{汗|あせ}をかく (to be drenched in sweat)
- ⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{汗|あせ}をかく (to sweat profusely)
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{汗|あせ}をかく (to work up a good sweat)
